note: Set A binds the tile, wallboard, gable and revision data correctly and keeps conditions (porcelain, brick layout, Fireclay Crush "Dandelion", revision descriptions), with only redundancy and one malformed dimension value as blemishes. Set B misbinds P3 as part of the L-bracket attachment (P3 is the gable finish), calls white thinset mortar the backsplash material rather than the adhesive, and invents a 'direction E' condition for the substrate slope (E is a grid line). B does capture useful title-block facts (lot number, team, BOREALIS, scales) that A omits, but its misbindings and vague entities (e.g. 'shower pan width 3"' for the curb) make it less faithful overall.
